name: Luna Illusia
age: Appears younger than high school students (child-like)

appearance.body: Small frame, almost entirely flat chest
appearance.outfit: Riding clothes, fox fur scarf (familiar named Lisitsa)

personality.demeanor: Puffs out cheeks when ignored, brags about herself, treats serious situations as games

abilities.magic_school: Lemegeton - oldest magic cabal inheriting King Solomon's magical system
abilities.minor_spirit_control: Can control hundreds of minor spirits simultaneously
abilities.barrier_magic: Creates complex curse barriers, can divide areas precisely
abilities.familiar: Lisitsa - a fox fur scarf that speaks with a boy's voice

equipment.solomons_bell: Modified with electrical amplification, can seal up to 6 million dead spirits
equipment.riding_crop: Uses to direct spirits and barriers

background: The last survivor of the Russian branch of Lemegeton, which had to join the former Soviet Union for protection after internal conflict weakened the cabal. She collects powerful spirits and Sex Gods, cultivating them like virtual pets. She holds a grudge against Saki for sealing Sex Gods she wanted for her collection.
goals: Collect divine-level spirits that can bend the laws of physics, get revenge on Saki for 'stealing' her Sex Gods

relationships.tokiwagi_saki: Enemy, wants revenge and to steal her sealed Sex Gods
relationships.lisitsa: Familiar, follows her orders and announces things
